title: 三镜飞逃
style: Hyper-speed phonk with frantic breakneck drums, clipped sub hits, and rubbery bass bounce; verse runs dense and breathless, pre-chorus narrows to taunting callouts, chorus slams with gang shouts and repeated hook chant. Vocal is close-mic, gritty, with doubled lines, rapid-fire ad-libs, and chopped backing echoes. Siren swells, reverse risers, and metallic impacts punch transitions; mix is dark, dry, and sharp with a hard neon-edge sheen., bounce, rock, fake
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
今夜开局，门锁发抖
三面镜子，照出出口
Math Driver 领路，算准每步
Alpha 到 delta，路线不糊

警笛在后，脚步在前
铁门一开，风就变脸
假装崩坏，假装失控
其实我们把局写进梦中

[Pre-Chorus]
快点，快点，别回头
右边那条路，直接走
Unit three three six，已盯上我们
可我们更快，像电一样猛

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in a hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

cash back drop，what a shock
chase and cage，free birds rock
a robin in hood!
but it’s for good!

[Verse 2]
从宅子里冲，像影子脱手
假做一场戏，真把门口偷走
“here’s my boys”——全员到位
thrash this toy，拆掉包围

换右车道，贴地飞过
thrash this toy，火花在躲
police chatter，碎在耳边
我们不慢，反而更尖

[Pre-Chorus]
快点，快点，别回头
烟雾一散，路就有
sarg 在吼，喊 chase and cage
可我们只信这一次逃走

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in a hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

cash back drop，what a shock
chase and cage，free birds rock
a robin in hood!
but it’s for good!

[Bridge]
三面镜里，照见真相
不是偷，是把枷锁撞响
Math Driver 说，计划已成
safe done sound，我们转身成风

[Final Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in a hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

bust em like we should，ha bro
if we could，就一路冲
our robin，our robin
our robin in our hood
